_comment: Ground truth for OWASP VAmPI (vulnerable=1), prepared by benchmarks/vampi_setup.py. Classes follow VAmPI's own vulnerability list: BOLA is GET /books/v1/{book_title} (any user reads another user's book secret), excessive data exposure is the /users/v1/_debug endpoint (plaintext passwords), mass assignment is the 'admin' field on register. corpus_runner reports missed/unexpected so you can refine.
